notes.title: Collectibles Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Dealers![/h2]

Here comes the [b]Collectibles Update[/b]! With this patch, you can now craft trophies, collect them, and proudly display them in your office.

[h3]What’s new?[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]New junkyard station - car crusher[/b]
Prepare a car that’s 100% mechanically functional. It must be also rust-free, washed, and polished. Once it meets all requirements, you can crush it into a trophy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/7101297d74e995519199455b2e4ac4fccaecf3e6.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Trophies with multiple tiers[/b]
Trophies are divided into: common, silver, gold, and diamond. Each higher tier requires crafting a certain number of figurines. You can find the details at the crusher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/1f0631fce89d6e280a29264bc742acb53101c50a.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Trophy shelf[/b]
Show off your crafted trophies in the office and impress your clients with your collection. Shelves are available in level 3 and 4 offices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/bb6f17b9db95bf55c6345883bdfe580df4a3df86.gif[/img]
 
[*] [b]New vehicle info app[/b]
A full vehicle encyclopedia has been added – you’ll find descriptions of every car, fun facts, and the new statistics feature. From now on, you can track things like: number of cars bought, kilometers driven, fuel consumed, and more. Stats are tracked starting from this patch, so your achievements begin now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/5aa9e04852d0a916bd141a9a4779c3282e5cf4af.png[/img]

[/list]

Enjoy the new possibilities and show off your trophies to your clients!

[b]And next week… can you guess what’s coming?
Yes, a brand-new sports car is speeding your way! 🚗💨[/b]

notes.title: Welcome to the Exciting World of Automotive Business!
notes.notes:
In today’s devlog, we want to tell you a little more about Little Sam’s family.

Yes, we know this guy can be a bit annoying at the beginning of the game. He’s never around when you need him, always off “handling something,” though no one really knows what that is - or if it’s even true 😊. He may seem like he’s got a lot on his plate, but who knows if he’s really that busy or just pretending? Luckily, he’s just your introduction to the game - and if you make enough money, you’ll be able to buy the Car Dealer from him! 😊

But it turns out Little Sam isn’t a lone wolf. He’s got a family that’s also involved in the automotive world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/87ecc28e692fe1d5962dfab9c9e56313dfa55ef1.png[/img]

In Car Rental Simulator, you’ll meet his son, Lazy Luke.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2242340/view/510712444576858140

His nickname didn’t come out of nowhere. He’s not exactly the hardworking type - just like his dad 😊 - except that Little Sam at least had a knack for picking good partners.

Lazy Luke is kind of a mess. He’s a slacker with no real business sense. He’d much rather spend money than earn it. Sure, Little Sam gave him a few cars to get his rental business started, but without your help, he doesn’t stand a chance.

Now, completely different is Little Sam’s wife and Lazy Luke’s mother - Clever Emma.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3542300/view/538859942242680861

Clever Emma is all about cleanliness and order. After finishing her role as a stay-at-home mom, she decided to start her own business - Car Cleaner. Now that she’s a bit older and more tired, she’ll need your help too.

Join the conversation and become part of our community:

[list]
[*] Buy and sell used parts,

notes.title: Car Dealer Simulator - an exciting world of cars
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Car Dealers![/h2]

In this devlog, we want to share with you a [b]brief summary of all the features in Car Dealer Simulator[/b].

You start your journey in a [b]rundown little car lot in Wingston Springs[/b], working as an [b]employee of Little Sam[/b]. He’s a strange guy who will introduce you to the ins and outs of the business. Over time, as your reputation grows and you earn money, you'll be able to [b]buy out the business and run it on your own[/b]. Your main goal is to [b]buy cheap and sell high[/b]. Here, your [b]negotiation skills[/b] are key.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/7804797ea2b08654dd510e7b6a5f871fb802ffa9.png[/img]

At first, you’ll be transporting cars with a [b]small trailer[/b], but eventually, you can earn enough for a [b]tow truck[/b]. That’s especially useful when the seller is far away or the car is not operational.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/84ab175af3a2d9de00f11282598d2fe6e54fb07c.png[/img]

With upgrades, you’ll be able to do [b]mechanical repairs, bodywork repairs[/b], and most importantly - [b]cosmetic detailing at the car wash[/b]. This helps increase the value of the cars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/dcf13da95d964e1d38e1e526b89bb0453fb7a2ef.png[/img]

Don’t forget the key spots in town like the [b]gas station and shop, parts store, junkyard, and bar[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/5674dea952f34573024b723e4f63f89d0e46c558.png[/img]

This is just the beginning of our journey with Car Dealer Simulator, because the [b]game will continue to evolve[/b]. In the meantime, we’ve got a real treat for you. [b]Starting today, Gas Station Simulator and all its DLCs from our friends at Drago Entertainment are on a historic sale[/b]. To celebrate, we’ve prepared a [b]special bundle[/b] for you.

[url=https://discord.gg/KVMHmsZNs6]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img]
[/url]

Imagine a world where you can become the [b]ultimate automotive impresario[/b]: one day you’re fueling up and helping drivers at [b]your own gas station on Route 66 in Gas Station Simulator[/b], and the next you’re[b] trading cars in a sleek dealership showroom in Wingston Springs in Car Dealer Simulator[/b]. What’s the secret ingredient that connects these games? [b]It’s you[/b]! A [b]virtuoso of entrepreneurship[/b], thriving both with socket wrenches and profit margins.

Both games place you at the helm of [b]lively businesses[/b] that need your [b]sharp managerial instincts[/b]. In [b]Gas Station Simulator[/b], you’ll scrub dirty pumps, stock up salty snacks, and upgrade every nozzle until your station gleams brighter than a freshly waxed hood. Meanwhile, in [b]Car Dealer Simulator[/b], you’ll negotiate with customers, refurbish cars, and display your best rides under showroom lights. The common thread? [b]Every tire you change and every buck you flip builds your empire[/b].

Most cars in Car Dealer Simulator are purchased through the [b]classifieds portal[/b]. Vehicles come in various conditions, and you can already check key info like [b]visual state[/b] and whether the car [b]starts or not[/b] directly in the listing.

In the [b]workshop[/b], however, you’ll need to specify exactly what you want done. A dialog window will show all the parts installed in the car - you can instruct the employee to remove them to your warehouse or replace them with another part from your inventory.

notes.title: GPS and Map – Your Guides to POIs and Tasks!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone! 👋[/h2]

In today’s devlog, we’re excited to introduce the interactive map and GPS system that will make managing tasks and navigating the city much more convenient. Both key Points of Interest (POIs) and available tasks are now displayed on the map, making it quick and intuitive to plan your next moves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/32a16a4c12ad9edd086c7c9804465999009b59d6.gif[/img]

[h2]How does the map and GPS work?[/h2]
The map in our game serves as the central hub for managing your activities around the city. Here’s what you’ll find:

[list]
[*]Points of Interest (POIs) – key locations such as:
[list]
[*]Gas Station – for refueling your vehicles.
[*]Parts Shop – to stock up on tools and parts.
[*]Workshop – your everyday workspace.
[/list]
[*]Tasks – icons representing missions you can take on, such as picking up a car from a client or delivering a vehicle to a specific location.
[/list]
Clicking on any marker – whether it’s a POI or a task – will automatically set a route in the GPS, helping you reach your destination with ease.

Today, we’re diving into a feature every dealership needs to master: refueling. Whether prepping a car for sale or making sure your latest acquisition runs smoothly, you’ll be spending some time at the pump. Let's take a closer look at how the refueling mechanic works in the Car Dealer Simulator and why it’s more than just topping off the tank!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/f7ec2c17e2ac7ffe231fd78e232859c6f63afb94.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Parking and Positioning: Fuel Up Like a Pro[/b][/h3]
First things first, when you roll up to the pump, it’s essential to get your car in the right spot. You’ll notice a visible zone next to the pump where your vehicle needs to be parked. Once you’re in position, the fun begins! With a click, you’ll grab the refueling gun, place it into the fuel filler, and get ready to refuel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/bd0f0a3712b877c3734dbc7818a70e607b0318cf.gif[/img]

Once the gun is in place, the refueling UI pops up, and you’ve got two options. You can either manually fill the tank by holding the LMB or switch on the Auto Fill feature to make things easier. Auto Fill lets you fill the tank without holding the button, allowing the fuel to flow until the tank is full—or your wallet runs dry!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/2db2b36a692c6b30012d20a07edbb0431461b3a3.gif[/img]

Once you’re done refueling, hit the button at the bottom of the UI to confirm your purchase. The game will notify you of the fuel added and the funds deducted from your account, so you’ll always know exactly where you stand. If you change your mind or realize you’re running low on cash, you can cancel the process and exit the UI anytime.

The refueling mechanic is designed to feel as natural and smooth as possible, whether you prefer doing things manually or letting the Auto Fill handle it for you. Every refueling session becomes essential to maintaining your cars, getting them ready for the road, or primed for sale.

[b]Sanding Down the Rust:[/b] Start by grabbing sandpaper and removing the rust by moving your mouse left and right. You’ll need a few solid passes to remove the rust and prep the surface.

If you’re unsure of what areas still need work, using radar will highlight unfinished spots, ensuring nothing gets left behind.

[/b]
Negotiations are about to get intense. Whether buying or selling, every move you make will have consequences. Our new system adds a layer of unpredictability - sometimes, it’s all about rolling the dice. But don’t worry, it’s not just luck that’s at play; your skills and strategy will make all the difference.

[b]NPC Archetypes: Know Your Opponent
[/b]
NPCs come in different flavors, each with their own quirks and negotiation styles:
[list]
[*] Honest Dealers: Straight shooters are likelier to give you a break in negotiations.
[*] Smarties: Slick talkers who might try to hide a defect or two but are still willing to haggle.
[*] Experts: These guys are tough cookies with keen eyes for flaws and a low tolerance for BS.
[/list]
Your negotiation strategy will need to adapt depending on who you're dealing with - so choose your words (and offers) wisely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/e02407f7a4d4d1d20a8df50f8b37920fa15ade43.gif[/img]

[b]Reading the Room: The Irritation Meter
[/b]
Each time you push your luck with a worse offer, you also try the NPC’s patience. We've introduced an irritation system that, using animation,  shows just how close your counterpart is to losing their cool. Push them too far, and the deal’s off! But don’t worry, you’ve got a few tricks up your sleeve to keep things civil - crack a joke, offer some candy, or maybe even a coffee. Just remember, timing is everything!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/6408604208e256b8e7d0114be182c404497ca112.gif[/img]

[b]Inspection Matters: Spot the Flaws
[/b]
Whenever you are the buyer, before you even start negotiating, you’ll have the chance to inspect the car. Find any hidden flaws? Use them to your advantage in the negotiation! Discovering a defect might give you the leverage to knock a few more bucks off the price.

[b]Dynamic Deals: Buying and Selling
[/b]
Negotiations aren’t just for buying; selling your cars will also require some serious negotiation chops. Whether you’re dealing with an amateur, an intermediate buyer, or a seasoned expert, their ability to spot issues and their negotiation tactics will vary. Your reputation is on the line, so make sure your ads are truthful - or be prepared to face the consequences!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/c67d8928b5f3def75ee95d16bcc85cde2c865dde.gif[/img]

[b]In Summary: The Thrill of the Deal
[/b]
With these new negotiation mechanics, every deal feels like a high-stakes poker game. You’ll need to read your opponent, manage their irritation, and play your cards right to come out on top. We can’t wait to see how you guys leverage these systems to score the best deals (or face hilarious failures).

Stay tuned for more updates and remember to add the free Prologue to your wishlist!

notes.title: A Closer Look at the Car Dealer Simulator’s Driving Mechanics
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/1fe9d91c32b2d0431c540e87ddf699d85e2528c1.png[/img]

[h3]Hello Dealers,[/h3]

We’re excited to share an update on Car Dealer Simulator as we continue to improve the game ahead of its release. Today, we want to talk about something you’ve often asked about—our car-driving mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/88148bb99d88b8e1030b77b4eb0b6a66c0be7021.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Driving Mechanics Overview[/b][/h3]

As a car dealer, you won’t just be managing your dealership; you’ll also get behind the wheel to test-drive the cars yourself. To make sure this aspect of the game feels right, we’ve integrated the Chaos Vehicles System from Unreal Engine 5. This system brings a solid and responsive driving experience, ensuring that every car you test-drive feels distinct.

[h3][b]Key Features[/b][/h3]

Here are some of the highlights of what we’ve been working on:

[b]Physics-Based Driving:[/b] The Chaos Vehicles System allows for more realistic vehicle physics. While it’s not a hardcore simulation, you’ll notice the weight and handling of each car as you drive. It’s balanced to be accessible and authentic, giving you a good sense of how each vehicle performs.

[b]Responsive Handling: [/b]We’ve worked hard to make the driving controls responsive and intuitive. The handling should feel natural and satisfying, whether you’re taking a leisurely drive or pushing a car to see what it can do.

[b]Different Experience for Different Cars: [/b]Many of you wanted to know if there will be multiple car models and types. Of course! More than that, we are doing our best to make the driving experience of each car model a bit different. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/5028d3f83002a9860a70275cd9a2049a666fd580.gif[/img]

[h3][b]What’s yet to be done?[/b][/h3]

Here are some of the things from our current TODO list:

[b]Visual and Feedback Improvements: [/b]Our HUD is not final yet, so we are working on developing the right one – simple yet useful. We would also like to add visual touches that enhance the driving experience, like suspension movement and tire reactions. These details are subtle but help make the driver feel more grounded.

[b]Customizable Controls:[/b] We know players have different preferences, so we’ve included options to adjust the driving controls to your liking. You can tweak the settings to find a balance that feels right. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/09c0e53d9a8d8b8112c820440c8d0a559253e126.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Preparing for Launch[/b][/h3]

As we approach release, we focus on refining these mechanics further. Our goal is to deliver a driving experience that complements the business management side of the game without overwhelming it. We want testing cars to be fun and an integral part of running your dealership.

[h3][b]Stay Tuned[/b][/h3]

We can’t wait for you to try these features for yourself when the game launches. In the meantime, we’ll continue to share updates on our progress. Your support means a lot to us as we work towards bringing Car Dealer Simulator to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/c3815f0198adb124ce4d079b7a50859590d84dbd.gif[/img]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/384a7ecf0c416d9fc75e25ff8dddd952d786c1b2.png[/img]

[h3]Hey there, future Car Dealers![/h3]

Let us show you around our first in-game garage. This small space may not look like much, but we are confident you will turn it into a fully working car repair station in no time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/3371d4f6a760f40fabfe2c8e593897b2c04539d0.png[/img]

This first garage will be located in one of three cities available in the game and will serve as your base of operations until you grow your car dealership empire. Bear in mind that this is still not the final look, but we wanted to show you the progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/800be074e0c58aaa87bff729d97d26c61a4283a9.png[/img]

We're also thrilled to share an exclusive sneak peek into the early development stages of [b]Car Dealer Simulator[/b]'s upcoming game mechanics. Today, we're showcasing two exciting prototypes: car washing and repairing car parts.

In these [b]in-engine[/b] captured short videos, you'll witness our team's approach to immerse you in the details of running a successful car dealership. Please note that these mechanics are still in their infancy, so don't mind the lack of proper textures and polish - we're focusing on functionality first!

[h2]Car washing[/h2]

Ever dreamed of running your own car wash within your dealership? Now you can! Watch as we demonstrate the basics of the car washing mechanic, from selecting the right tools to washing away grime and dirt (currently represented as colours) to reveal that shiny exterior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/6dfaa574bb1c6461a993cf28efaf1e2b79c309ea.gif[/img]

[b]What we aim for[/b]

You'll have the option to wash the car with just water, which will lightly improve its appearance. Or, you can add appropriate cleaning products for a more thorough cleaning to achieve optimal cleanliness. Additionally, applying wax will not only make the car clean but also give it a shiny finish, adding to its appeal.

[h2]Part repairing[/h2]

In [b]Car Dealer Simulator[/b], attention to detail is key, and that includes making sure every part of your vehicles is in top-notch condition. Check out our early prototype showcasing the process of repairing car parts. From identifying damaged components to using the right tools for the job, get ready to roll up your sleeves and get hands-on with vehicle maintenance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44018181/2975ad4d973a32711d85eda91d157bbb3bf90830.gif[/img]

[b]What we aim for[/b]

In the final game, you can look forward to a nuanced mechanic that distinguishes the functionality of different screws. While all screws can be tightened, there are subtle differences; some screws may offer resistance, requiring a bit more manual effort with the wrench.

We're beyond excited to continue refining these mechanics to deliver an authentic and engaging gameplay experience. Stay tuned for more updates as we progress further in development!

[h3]Keep revving those engines, and see you in the next dev update![/h3]
